images.title: 가을 거실에서 달력을 보며 웃는 노부부 (대표사진)
images.prompt: In a cozy autumn living room, the grandma and grandpa sit side by side on a sofa, smiling and pointing together at a small blank wall calendar. A cup of warm tea on a low table. The Seonggeul grandma: a Korean woman in her late 70s, short white curly hair, round glasses, apricot knit cardigan. The Seonggeul grandpa: a Korean man in his late 70s, short gray hair, mint green vest over a white shirt. Soft matte clay 3D render, rounded chunky shapes, handmade plasticine texture, gentle soft studio lighting, pastel colors, clean simple background, cozy and warm mood, miniature diorama feel. Use mainly these colors: cream (#F6EFE3) background, apricot (#F2B8A0), mint (#A8D8C8), soft sky blue (#A9C8E8), warm brown (#8A6A55). Korean people and Korean everyday settings. Friendly, calm expressions. No syringes, no needles, no blood, no one in pain, nothing scary. Do not include any text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks in the image. Keep the top third of the image as plain empty cream background with nothing in it, so a title can be placed there later. Put all subjects in the lower two thirds.
